# Read Primitives — Map Construction

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Construct map from key-value pairs

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  ps_suppkey,
  MAP(ARRAY_AGG(CAST(ps_partkey AS VARCHAR)), ARRAY_AGG(ps_supplycost)) AS part_costs
FROM partsupp
WHERE
  ps_suppkey <= 10
GROUP BY
  ps_suppkey
ORDER BY
  ps_suppkey
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def map_construction_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Construct map from key-value pairs.

    Expression-family implementation using map construction.
    """
    return _partsupp_map_expression(ctx, 10).select("ps_suppkey", "part_costs")
```
